text:
The court should apply Washington law, including its general prohibition on punitive damages, because in a diversity case the forum state’s choice-of-law rules govern, and Washington would likely apply its own law to a tort claim brought by a Washington resident for an injury occurring in California only if Washington has a more significant relationship to the occurrence and the parties; here, since the injury and conduct occurred in California, Washington’s choice-of-law rules would likely point to California law, allowing punitive damages.  
CONFIDENCE: 70
